name: mai-ai
description: MAI Cognitive Entity Interface — web interface runtime dependencies.

maiStackPolicy.plan: docs/Mai_documentation/03-Features/MAI Cognitive Entity Interface Plan.md (v4.0, sections 22-23)
maiStackPolicy.rule: GSAP orchestrates animation, Three.js renders the MAI Entity only, Canvas 2D renders the knowledge graph, and native CSS handles UI. There is deliberately no UI framework and no bundler.
maiStackPolicy.why: v4.0 section 23 rejects multiple animation engines competing over the same properties. Adding any package listed in deliberatelyAbsent will reintroduce exactly that failure.
maiStackPolicy.vendoring: Runtime ES modules are served from api/web/vendor/ so the PWA works offline. This manifest records provenance and versions; it is not a build step.
